verdict.rationale: Unstructured is a document-processing and ETL service whose MCP role is as a server (its Transform MCP server lets AI tools call it). Consuming third-party MCP servers as a client is an agent or host-app role outside this product's category. The server-side MCP evidence is a different story and is not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
